text_block_list.text:
The day of the Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival.
I spotted Yaeno Muteki and the others preparing for an event titled the 'Fiery Handshake Session.'

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiight, time to show our fans some appreciation!
Every single one of 'em, thoroughly and properly!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Everyone always gets me so fired up! Let's mingle as much as we can!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
In addition, I believe it's a great opportunity
to let many people outside our fanbase get to know us.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let us provide hospitality with all our hearts
so that this gathering proves to be truly fruitful.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No need to rush, everyone!
Please form a single line, okay?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna look you in the eyes and talk to you properly!
So please, I'd really appreciate your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Waah, even fan service is a head-on clash?!
We have to line up properly! Eyes front!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for coming out, everyone!
A handshake alone won't do—let's take some photos too!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Come on, get closer!
Let's link arms and stuff
and take pictures in all kinds of poses!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!?
Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Bamboo-san and Ace-san.
Their fan service is truly worthy of respect.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must strive to hype things up
with such pleasant and lively energy as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu! Welcome, thank you for coming!
Thank you so much for your continuous support!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not just handshakes, if you have any requests,
just name it! Don't be shy!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Yaeno-san!
Please fire yourself up! Osu!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
A-A pep talk...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Um, like taking photos or signing autographs, for instance...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text:
No!
I rushed over purely with the desire
to have Yaeno-san fire me up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Is that so?
However, it's the Thanksgiving Festival...
Will that really suffice as a thank-you...?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's what makes me happy!
Because I, too, walk the path of the warrior!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text: Please, teach me! I want to aim for greater heights, just like you, Yaeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if that is the case.
Then, how should we...
choice_data_list: Let's fire things up with a loud voice!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
...Deep breeeeaaath—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: FOCUS!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Uwoh, received loud and clear!
Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Yaeno Muteki's fan service
is really hyping up the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That looks like a total energy boost!
I wanna get one done too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, did the air in the gym just shake?!
Not bad, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Totally agree!
We can't afford to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I never expected them to be so delighted.
It is truly the result of giving it our all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I have realized that fan service is nothing less than laying bare one's very soul!
Yaeno Muteki seems to have grasped something, but the 'Hot-Blooded Handshake Event' has only just begun.
choice_data_list: Stay focused until the very last person!
Stay focused until the very last person, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the main stars today are the fans.
I shall face each and every one of them head-on.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Without pride or haughtiness,
let us fulfill our duty to the very end! Osu!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Uwooh, thank you very much!
Thanks to you, I'm all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, not bad.
Just what I'd expect from Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah.
That's what the Fan Thanksgiving is all about!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, that gave me a great feel for it.
I must make sure not to forget this sensation!
Yaeno Muteki seems to have grasped something, but the 'Hot-Blooded Handshake Event' has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Hyoe!?
Ah, awawa, um—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text: I-I'll start over and train even harder~~~!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah!?
choice_data_list: I guess I got a bit too hyped up...
You got a bit too hyped up, huh...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
It seems I still have much more room for improvement...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood!
Here I go!
(Grab!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hmph!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Uwooh, your burning fighting spirit resonates in my soul!
Thank you very much! Osu!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: What's that? That looks like so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get in line too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The handshake line for Yaeno's getting long!
The gym's really livening up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"That heat, that energy!
Now this is what the Thanksgiving Festival is all about!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh, how truly delightful it is to see the fans rejoicing so close at hand.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I shall never forget the smiles burned into my eyes.
It seems I, too, have received strength from you."
